channel.title: North Wales Pioneer - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from North Wales Pioneer (northwalespioneer.co.uk)

item.title: Thousands of pubs, restaurants, cafes, and live music venues to receive new support
item.description: Thousands of pubs, restaurants, cafes, and music venues in Wales to receive 15% business rates relief in 2026–27, Finance Secretary Mark Drakeford announces.

item.title: Meet the North Wales women making a difference with direct and compassionate care
item.description: Three lawyers are making a difference through direct and compassionate care.

item.title: HMRC Personal Allowance update: Millions of pensioners spared State Pension tax
item.description: UK pensioners have welcomed clarity on HMRC personal allowance rules, after the government confirmed that retirees whose only income is the State Pension will not pay income tax, despite the personal allowance remaining frozen.

item.title: Flintshire doggy daycare's warning after case of deadly parvovirus confirmed
item.description: The facility is urging dog owners to be vigilant for the signs of the virus

item.title: Man who was treated at Llandudno hospital experienced ‘injustice’ – report
item.description: A man whose daughter complained about the treatment he received at Llandudno Community Hospital suffered an “injustice,” a report found.

item.title: Conversion of closed Old Colwyn social club into affordable flats falls through
item.description: Plans to convert a closed social club in Old Colwyn into affordable apartments have fallen through.

item.title: Llandudno lands £20m boost to transform its neighbourhoods
item.description: Tudno and Mostyn wards in Llandudno have been chosen for up to £20 million in UK Government funding aimed at tackling deprivation, improving public spaces and creating new opportunities for local residents.

item.title: Colwyn Bay ex-Red Cross A&E worker alleges pay and staffing issues after BCUHB TUPE
item.description: The worker, who wishes to remain anonymous, was part of a British Red Cross team in the Accident and Emergency department at Glan Clwyd.

item.title: ‘It looks like a bombsite’: Fresh concern over state of Conwy’s Civic Hall
item.description: Councillors have raised fresh concerns about the state of Conwy’s Grade‑II Listed Civic Hall, branding it an “eyesore” and urging the council to tidy up the landmark building ahead of the busy summer season.

item.title: Housing association reveals bid for 12 affordable homes in Dwygyfylchi
item.description: A housing association has submitted plans to build 12 affordable homes on land at Dwygyfylchi, with proposals including new access, an internal road and landscaping at a site close to the coastline, Eryri National Park and the Carneddau range.
